<!doctype html><html lang="pt-BR"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover,user-scalable=no">
<title>Desafio DPI — EL-X VET</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#021a31;color:#fff;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{color:#fff}
.app{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:430px;min-height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;background:
radial-gradient(circle at 84% 14%,#0a8b8b88 0 10%,transparent 32%),
radial-gradient(circle at 8% 58%,#0069a577 0 8%,transparent 30%),
radial-gradient(circle at 74% 78%,#00a76c44,transparent 27%),
linear-gradient(155deg,#031b37 0%,#064765 48%,#00605c 100%);padding-bottom:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.app:before,.app:after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;border:14px solid #23d7f218;box-shadow:0 0 45px #1bd7ff18}
.app:before{width:280px;height:280px;left:-185px;top:185px}.app:after{width:360px;height:360px;right:-260px;top:290px;border-color:#6bff4013}
header{position:relative;z-index:3;margin:10px 10px 0;border:1px solid #20bfe788;border-radius:16px;background:#031f3cdd;box-shadow:0 0 24px #18c7f52a;overflow:hidden}
.brandbar{height:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;gap:9px;border-bottom:1px solid #19aedd55}
.exit{border:0;background:none;font-size:23px;width:25px;padding:0}.divider{height:25px;width:1px;background:#23d1f07a}
.brandmini{width:27px;height:auto;max-height:27px;object-fit:contain}.brandname{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:17px}.subtitle{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#d5f7ff;white-space:nowrap}
.utility{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);height:57px}.utility button{border:0;border-right:1px solid #25c7e766;background:#052a49aa;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 1px}.utility button:last-child{border-right:0}.utility b{display:block;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:2px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px currentColor)}
.utility button:nth-child(1) b{color:#6cf25c}.utility button:nth-child(2) b{color:#39d8ff}.utility button:nth-child(3) b{color:#ffd44a}.utility button:nth-child(4) b{color:#bf72ff}
main{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:10px 12px 8px}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:322px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:245px;height:245px;border-radius:50%;border:14px solid #1bd8f014;box-shadow:0 0 65px #32e4d622}
.emblem{width:176px;height:auto;max-height:176px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #52ff6144)}
.wordmark{font-size:37px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:4px;margin-top:-9px}.submark{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px;margin-top:2px}.plantao{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#6df348;margin-top:13px;text-shadow:0 0 10px #55ff66}
.sideleft,.sideright{position:absolute;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;max-width:122px;text-align:left}.sideleft{left:0;top:91px;font-style:italic;transform:rotate(-5deg)}.sideright{right:0;top:75px;text-align:right}.sideright strong{display:block;color:#d8ffff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px}.evolve{margin-top:20px;color:#fff;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:1px}
.actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:2px}.action{min-height:105px;border-radius:21px;padding:13px;text-align:left;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff22;transition:.15s transform,.15s filter}.action:active{transform:scale(.975);filter:brightness(1.16)}.action i{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:43px;height:43px;border:2px solid currentColor;border-radius:13px;font-style:normal;font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 0 17px currentColor}.action strong{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px}.action small{font-size:7px;opacity:.8}.green{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#003d35,#008f5d);border-color:#44ff76;box-shadow:0 0 22px #25ff6c66}.blue{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#043660,#006ea8);border-color:#35d8ff;box-shadow:0 0 22px #2bd4ff66}.purple{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#311064,#7221a8);border-color:#b866ff;box-shadow:0 0 22px #aa4cff66}.gold{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#6b3900,#b66a00);border-color:#ffb918;box-shadow:0 0 22px #ffab1766}
footer{position:relative;z-index:3;margin:9px 10px 0;border:1px solid #20c8e877;border-radius:17px;background:#03223ddd;overflow:hidden}.footlinks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:62px}.footlinks a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px;border-right:1px solid #2bd2ee77}.footlinks a:last-child{border:0}.footlinks b{font-size:22px;color:#58ef64}.footlinks small{display:block;font-size:6px;color:#9fd5dd}.motto{border-top:1px solid #20c8e744;text-align:center;padding:8px 4px 5px;color:#91e7ed;font-size:6px;letter-spacing:3px}.copy{text-align:center;font-size:5px;padding-bottom:6px;color:#82b3bd}
.view{display:none}.view.on{display:block}.panel{margin:8px 0 12px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #31d6f0;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#04314feF,#075d68eF);box-shadow:0 12px 30px #00182d99,0 0 20px #2bd6ee22}.panel h2{margin:0 0 7px}.muted{font-size:10px;color:#b9dce4}.btn{width:100%;margin:6px 0;padding:12px;border:1px solid #37d6f3;border-radius:15px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#064d72,#087c80);font-weight:800}.option{text-align:left;font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,24px)!important;line-height:1.35!important}.question-text{font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,32px)!important;line-height:1.3!important}.field{width:100%;padding:11px;margin:5px 0 9px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #32cce9;background:#032d48;color:#fff}
.modal{position:fixed;z-index:1000;inset:0;display:none;place-items:center;background:#011426eF;padding:16px}.modal.on{display:grid}.modalbox{width:min(400px,100%);max-height:90dvh;overflow:auto;padding:17px;border:1px solid #32d8f2;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#043653,#08626b);box-shadow:0 0 55px #28d8ee44}
#party{position:fixed;z-index:1100;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}.confetti{position:absolute;top:-15px;width:8px;height:14px;animation:fall 1.55s ease-in forwards}@keyframes fall{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),105vh) rotate(720deg);opacity:.1}}.react{position:fixed;left:50%;top:43%;font-size:74px;animation:pop .9s ease forwards}@keyframes pop{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.3)}50%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.35)}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);opacity:0}}.firework{position:absolute;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 -35px #6cff58,25px -25px #27d9ff,35px 0 #ffd43b,25px 25px #ff58da,0 35px #6cff58,-25px 25px #27d9ff,-35px 0 #ffd43b,-25px -25px #ff58da;animation:boom .8s ease-out forwards}@keyframes boom{to{transform:scale(1.7);opacity:0}}
@media(max-width:365px){.wordmark{font-size:32px}.emblem{width:158px;height:158px}.hero{min-height:300px}.sideleft,.sideright{font-size:7px;max-width:78px}.utility button{font-size:7px}}
</style><style id="v9-feedback">
.feedback{margin-top:10px;padding:12px 13px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid;animation:feedbackIn .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1)}
.feedback.ok{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#064a35,#07825a);border-color:#72ff83;box-shadow:0 0 25px #4cff7460}
.feedback.no{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#64223a,#8b3048);border-color:#ff7890;box-shadow:0 0 25px #ff536060}
.feedback strong{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:5px}.feedback p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin:0}
@keyframes feedbackIn{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.97)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.option.okpick{border-color:#7dff78!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#087044,#0a9b61)!important;box-shadow:0 0 26px #5aff6b77!important}
.option.badpick{border-color:#ff7388!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#74273d,#a7354d)!important;box-shadow:0 0 26px #ff536077!important;animation:shake .28s linear}
@keyframes shake{25%{transform:translateX(-5px)}50%{transform:translateX(5px)}75%{transform:translateX(-3px)}}
</style><style id="v10-variety">
.feedback.variant2{transform:rotate(-.35deg)}.feedback.variant3{border-radius:28px 12px 28px 12px}
.stamp{position:absolute;right:14px;top:10px;font-size:28px;animation:stamp .45s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.3,1)}
@keyframes stamp{0%{transform:scale(2) rotate(-18deg);opacity:0}100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(6deg);opacity:1}}
.spark{position:fixed;z-index:1102;font-size:28px;animation:sparkfly 1.1s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes sparkfly{to{transform:translate(var(--sx),var(--sy)) rotate(280deg) scale(.3);opacity:0}}
.screenflash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1099;pointer-events:none;animation:flash .42s ease-out forwards}
.screenflash.good{background:#61ff7a32}.screenflash.bad{background:#ff48682a}
@keyframes flash{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:0}}
.cheer{position:fixed;z-index:1103;left:50%;top:29%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:20px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 0 18px #fff;animation:cheer 1.1s ease forwards}
@keyframes cheer{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,20px) scale(.7)}35%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1.16)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-16px) scale(1)}}
</style><style id="v11-refine">
.headerbrand{height:34px;width:auto;max-width:82%;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center;border-radius:5px}
.brandbar{gap:12px}.brandlock{display:block;width:min(255px,68vw);height:auto;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;margin-top:12px}
.hero{min-height:335px}.sideleft{font-family:"Segoe Print","Comic Sans MS",cursive;font-size:10px;line-height:1.7;max-width:112px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 10px #1bdcff55}.sideleft span{color:#8dff71}
.sideright{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:9px;line-height:1.7;max-width:102px;letter-spacing:1px}.sideright strong{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#dfffff;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.4px}
.evolve{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:9px;line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:1.5px}
.plantao{font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 0 12px #54ff55aa}
.waicon{color:#55ef68!important;font-size:24px!important;transform:rotate(-18deg)}.webicon{font-size:22px!important;color:#62dcff!important}
.navrow{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.navrow .btn{margin:0;min-height:40px}.navrow .secondary{background:#032b49;border-color:#50a8bd;color:#bfe9f1}
.feedback{margin-bottom:0}
.miniStage{text-align:center;padding:8px}.miniTitle{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;margin:8px 0}.miniHelp{font-size:10px;color:#bce5ec}
.targetArena{height:160px;position:relative;border:1px solid #34d4ef;border-radius:18px;background:#032944;overflow:hidden}.targetDot{position:absolute;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0 8%,#ffda34 9% 27%,#ff4c5f 28% 48%,#35d8ff 49%);box-shadow:0 0 25px #31d9ff;left:43%;top:34%}
.lightning{font-size:50px;animation:pulseMini .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes pulseMini{to{transform:scale(1.16);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #62efff)}}
.hangword{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:8px;font-weight:900;color:#82f56a}.assocgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.assocgrid button{min-height:65px}
</style><style id="v11r-logo-fix">
.headerbrand{
  width:148px!important;height:42px!important;max-width:55%!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;object-position:left center!important;
  background:transparent!important;border-radius:0!important;
}
.brandlock{
  width:min(250px,64vw)!important;height:auto!important;max-height:none!important;
  object-fit:contain!important;background:transparent!important;border-radius:0!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #51ff5740)!important;
}
.hero{min-height:340px!important}
.sideleft{
  left:0!important;top:78px!important;width:78px!important;max-width:78px!important;
  font-size:9px!important;line-height:1.9!important;z-index:3!important;
}
.sideright{
  right:0!important;top:62px!important;width:92px!important;max-width:92px!important;z-index:3!important;
}
.sideright strong{font-size:9.5px!important;line-height:1.55!important}
.evolve{font-size:9.5px!important;line-height:1.85!important}
.plantao{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:3.4px!important}
.waicon{
  width:26px;height:26px;display:inline-grid!important;place-items:center;
  color:#52f26c!important;transform:none!important;
}
.waicon svg{width:25px;height:25px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #52f26c88)}
.action{min-height:99px!important}
</style>
<style id="v23-home-layout-v24">
/* V24: preservar o lockup original; deslocar o elemento principal abaixo das chamadas laterais. */
#home .hero{min-height:480px!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;padding-top:174px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;}
#home .brandlock{margin-top:0!important;position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;}
#home .sideleft{top:28px!important;left:4px!important;width:112px!important;max-width:112px!important;font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.55!important;transform:none!important;text-align:left!important;}
#home .sideleft span{display:inline-block;font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.32!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:0!important;}
#home .sideright{top:25px!important;right:4px!important;width:138px!important;max-width:138px!important;text-align:right!important;}
#home .sideright strong{font-size:14.25px!important;line-height:1.34!important;letter-spacing:.5px!important;}
#home .sideright .evolve{font-size:14.25px!important;line-height:1.35!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important;margin-top:9px!important;}
@media(max-width:365px){
 #home .hero{min-height:475px!important;padding-top:180px!important;}
 #home .sideleft{width:103px!important;max-width:103px!important;}
 #home .sideleft span{font-size:13px!important;}
 #home .sideright{width:124px!important;max-width:124px!important;}
 #home .sideright strong,#home .sideright .evolve{font-size:12.5px!important;}
}
</style>

<style id="v25-home-visual-tuning">
/* Ajuste restrito ao cabeçalho e à apresentação da home; jogo e voz intactos. */
.headerbrand{width:91px!important;height:46px!important;max-width:91px!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;border-radius:0!important}
#home .hero{min-height:390px!important;padding-top:136px!important;justify-content:flex-start!important}
#home .brandlock{width:min(260px,68vw)!important;margin-top:0!important;flex-shrink:0!important}
#home .sideleft{top:39px!important;left:5px!important;width:100px!important;max-width:100px!important;font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.5!important;font-weight:600!important;font-style:italic!important;transform:rotate(-3deg)!important}
#home .sideright{top:27px!important;right:4px!important;width:127px!important;max-width:127px!important;text-align:right!important}
#home .sideright strong{font-size:11px!important;line-height:1.42!important;letter-spacing:.75px!important}
#home .sideright .evolve{font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.62!important;letter-spacing:1.2px!important;margin-top:13px!important}
#home .plantao{display:block!important;position:relative!important;z-index:3!important;margin-top:16px!important;padding:0 6px!important;max-width:100%!important;font-size:clamp(12px,3.55vw,16px)!important;line-height:1.35!important;letter-spacing:clamp(1px,.35vw,2px)!important;font-weight:900!important;color:#a1ff6b!important;text-align:center!important;text-shadow:0 0 11px #4cfa71aa!important}
#home .plantao:before,#home .plantao:after{content:'—';color:#55f2ab;margin:0 5px}
#home .actions{margin-top:9px!important}
@media(max-width:365px){#home .hero{min-height:382px!important;padding-top:139px!important}#home .sideleft{width:88px!important;max-width:88px!important;font-size:10px!important}#home .sideright{width:113px!important;max-width:113px!important}#home .sideright strong{font-size:10px!important}#home .sideright .evolve{font-size:9.5px!important}#home .plantao{margin-top:13px!important;font-size:12px!important;letter-spacing:1px!important}}
</style>
<style id="v26-approved-home">
/* A tela aprovada é aplicada como arte exata, sem redesenhar a marca.
   As regiões clicáveis mantêm as funções originais do jogo. */
body:has(#home.on) .app>header,body:has(#home.on) .app>footer{display:none!important}
body:has(#home.on) .app{width:min(100%,870px)!important;max-width:870px!important;padding:0!important;margin:0 auto!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}
body:has(#home.on) .app>main{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;max-width:none!important;background:transparent!important}
#home.on{display:block!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:transparent!important}
.v26-stage{position:relative;width:100%;line-height:0;isolation:isolate}
.v26-approved-art{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.v26-hotspot{position:absolute;z-index:2;display:block;border:0;background:transparent;color:transparent;cursor:pointer;padding:0;margin:0;box-shadow:none;line-height:normal;touch-action:manipulation}
.v26-hotspot:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b0ff39;outline-offset:-4px;border-radius:12px}
@media(min-width:871px){body:has(#home.on){background:#06334b!important}}
</style>
<style id="dpi-final-readability-fix">
/* Correção consolidada de legibilidade — sem alterar o layout V26 */
.question-text, .question-text b { font-size: clamp(22px, 2.2vw, 32px) !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; }
.option, .option * { font-size: clamp(17px, 1.55vw, 24px) !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; }
</style>

</head><body><div class="app">
<header><div class="brandbar"><button class="exit" onclick="showHome()">×</button><span class="divider"></span><img class="headerbrand" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="EL-X VET — Telerradiologia Veterinária"></div>
<div class="utility"><button onclick="profile()"><b>👤</b>MEU PERFIL</button><button onclick="settings()"><b>⚙</b>CONFIGURAÇÕES</button><button onclick="ranking()"><b>🏆</b>RANKING</button><button onclick="bankView()"><b>▣</b>BANCO</button></div></header>
<main>
<section id="home" class="view on"><div class="v26-stage"><img class="v26-approved-art" src="data:image/png;base64,
